Title: New recommendations for operational excellence are now available in Azure Advisor

Body.Content:
Azure Advisor now includes the following new best practice recommendations for operational excellence:

  • Ensure that at least one host pool is Validation Environment enabled. This promotes business continuity through Windows Virtual Desktop service deployments with early detection of potential issues. Learn more
  • Make sure not too many host pools have Validation Environment enabled. Less than half of your host pools should be Validation Environment enabled. This allows you to best utilize the benefits of the multistage deployments that Windows Virtual Desktop offers with certain updates.
  • Use Traffic Analytics to view insights into traffic patterns across Azure resources. This cloud-based solution provides visibility into your user and application activity in Azure.

Visit Advisor operational excellence documentation to learn more
